OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with no
                separators, unifying the former customer code and membership number.
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range); FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (which starts on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date; HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalized telephone followed by the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation time and carrying no sequence
                number; a value that collides with an existing owner's is de-duplicated by
                appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment carried by the owner's member id (the fiscal year,
                which starts on 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registration date
                baked into the member id at creation time; e.g. 'FY26' for a registration
                date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Read back from the member id.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the member id: its leading '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold at the time this response is produced: the
                owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable
                mail provider, i.e. the lower-cased domain equals or ends with '.' plus a
                listed disposable domain); or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (it already holds at least 40 owners, the soft capacity, short of the hard
                capacity limit of 50). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; the
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} endpoint flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived from the owner's own id; null until the owner has
                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with no
                separators, unifying the former customer code and membership number.
                REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range); FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year (which starts on 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration
                date; HASH8 is the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256
                digest of the owner's normalized telephone followed by the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation time and carrying no sequence
                number; a value that collides with an existing owner's is de-duplicated by
                appending '-<n>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment carried by the owner's member id (the fiscal year,
                which starts on 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registration date
                baked into the member id at creation time; e.g. 'FY26' for a registration
                date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Read back from the member id.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the member id: its leading '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold at the time this response is produced: the
                owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable
                mail provider, i.e. the lower-cased domain equals or ends with '.' plus a
                listed disposable domain); or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (it already holds at least 40 owners, the soft capacity, short of the hard
                capacity limit of 50). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; the
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} endpoint flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived from the owner's own id; null until the owner has
                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

      required:
        - content

    PetPage:
      title: Pet page

      properties:
        content:

          description: Pets in the requested page.

          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:

        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:

      properties:

    Pet:

    PetTypeFields:

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.

    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional key that makes the create idempotent. A repeated create
            carrying a key already seen returns the originally created owner
            instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title. When supplied it is one of
            'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR' and drives the derived 'salutation'.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility as a flat, single-line address. When the structured
            'addressLine1' field is supplied it takes precedence over this
            field. On a response this is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address' field,
            and is normalized the same way (trimmed, internal whitespace
            collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and that E.164 string is what is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when present it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when present.
            When present it must be valid for the city's region per the fixed table
            (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD
            4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            belongs to the same household (same last name and postcode, hence the same
            computed householdId); the owner is created as a declared household member
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Without it, a second owner in an
            existing household is rejected as a duplicate (409). Optional; defaults to
            false. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the last
                name when the owner has no title. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a single space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                separated by spaces (e.g. '+61 412 345 678' for the stored
                '+61412345678'). Derived from the owner's own 'telephone'.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract carried by this response.
                Always 2: the three identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId)
                are grouped under 'identity' and each is derived under the version-2
                algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the two-digit
                fiscal-year segment carried by the owner's member id (the fiscal year,
                which starts on 1 July, of the business-day-adjusted registration date
                baked into the member id at creation time; e.g. 'FY26' for a registration
                date between 1 July 2025 and 30 June 2026). Read back from the member id.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized last name and the postcode joined by '|'. Every owner that
                shares a last name and postcode therefore carries the same value, with
                no opt-in required. Null for owners created without a postcode.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, derived from the owner's own fields:
                starting at 0, gaining 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the
                owner is unique (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more
                members, and 3 when tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from the
                membership points: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points, and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region carried by the member id: its leading '<REGION>'
                segment, the region derived from the postcode at creation time.
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via
                the fixed region-to-timezone table: NSW -> 'Australia/Sydney',
                VIC -> 'Australia/Melbourne', QLD -> 'Australia/Brisbane'. Null when
                the locality is not one of these regions.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's own
                fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered for the
                current business day at the time this response is produced, flagging
                an unusually high volume of same-day signups; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners at
                the time this response is produced, flagging that the city is
                approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when any of these hold at the time this response is produced: the
                owner is a possible duplicate ('possibleDuplicate' is true); the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable
                mail provider, i.e. the lower-cased domain equals or ends with '.' plus a
                listed disposable domain); or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (it already holds at least 40 owners, the soft capacity, short of the hard
                capacity limit of 50). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, was created sharing
                an existing owner's last name and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this one was flagged a possible duplicate
                of; null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's identity key, a single derived value consolidating all
                duplicate detection: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. A new owner is
                rejected as a duplicate only when its whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's; because the telephone is part of the key, two owners
                with the same last name and postcode but different telephones have
                different identity keys and the second is created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as it stands on the
                'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when the owner has no birth date.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false; the
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} endpoint flags it true while retaining the record. The
                create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks ignore owners flagged deleted.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived from the owner's own id; null until the owner has
                been assigned an id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

    PetPage:

      properties:

        page:

          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        size:

          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages

          example: 2
      required:

        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:

      properties:

          description: The name of the pet.

paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          description: >-
            Optional key that makes the create idempotent. A repeated create
            carrying a key already seen returns the originally created owner
            instead of creating a duplicate.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

          description: Number of items per page.

          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1

                type: string
          content:
            application/json:

        304:

        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:

        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
